dataset.selection: first 600 lidar/*.bin objects in ascending timestamp order

ground_truth_isolation.scan_phase: download only the selected lidar binary objects; do not download applanix or calibration
ground_truth_isolation.trajectory_phase: generate and hash v6 primary, official KISS 1.3.0 reference, and frozen v10 trajectories against a synthetic identity reference
ground_truth_isolation.metric_phase: download only applanix/lidar_poses.csv after all trajectory hashes are fixed

evaluation.comparison: v10 versus its v6 primary and official KISS reference on the same 600 scans
evaluation.interpretation: external transfer validation; no promotion threshold or parameter selection is allowed
